steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p0_concat_numbers (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, w VARCHAR(10), n INT, big BIGINT, small TINYINT, u INT UNSIGNED, b BOOLEAN, dt DATETIME, dd DATE, t TIME, y YEAR) ENGINE=InnoDB
INSERT INTO p0_concat_numbers (id, name, w, n, big, small, u, b, dt, dd, t, y) VALUES (1, 'ada', 'x', 7, 70, 3, 9, 1, '2026-01-02 03:04:05', '2026-01-02', '10:20:30', 2026)
SELECT CONCAT(name, w) AS two_words FROM p0_concat_numbers
SELECT CONCAT(name, n) AS word_and_int FROM p0_concat_numbers
SELECT CONCAT(n) AS int_alone FROM p0_concat_numbers
SELECT CONCAT(big) AS wide, CONCAT(small) AS narrow, CONCAT(u) AS unsigned_one, CONCAT(b) AS boolish FROM p0_concat_numbers
SELECT CONCAT(name, '-', n) AS word_dash_int FROM p0_concat_numbers
SELECT CONCAT(id, name) AS key_and_word FROM p0_concat_numbers
SELECT CONCAT(dt) AS moment, CONCAT(dd) AS day, CONCAT(t) AS span, CONCAT(y) AS year FROM p0_concat_numbers
